Questions? We've got you.

We know, it sounds too good to be true. But it’s real. Here’s how.

What are the eSIM plans available in Europe?

The best eSIM plans available in Europe cater to various data needs. Firsty offers both free and paid plans for seamless connectivity. With Firsty Free, you receive ad-supported data for basic internet use. For heavy data users needing high-speed internet for streaming and video calls, Unlimited is ideal, especially in cities like Paris, Berlin, and Rome.

How can I activate a travel eSIM for Europe?

Activating a travel eSIM for Europe is straightforward:

1. Ensure you have a stable Wi-Fi connection to download the Firsty app.

2. Open the app and follow the easy setup process to activate your free eSIM.

3. When you arrive in Europe, your connection will be ready immediately.

4. For faster internet, upgrade to Classic or Unlimited, which you can purchase and activate anytime without needing WiFi.

Does eSIM for Europe come with unlimited data?

Firsty’s eSIM for Europe offers unlimited data through Firsty Free, allowing you to use essential apps like WhatsApp, Email, and Navigation without any cost. For high-speed internet and more data-intensive activities, you can upgrade to Classic or Unlimited anytime. This plan also lets you pause the service, ensuring you get the most value from your data without waste, especially when traveling between major cities. Saving data can also come in handy in case of emergencies, ensuring you always have access when you need it most.

What is the best way to get data in Europe?

The most efficient way to get data in Europe is by using Firsty Free or purchasing days of fast data through the Firsty app. Europe’s top mobile internet providers include Vodafone, Orange, and Deutsche Telekom. With Firsty, you automatically connect to the fastest provider based on your location, whether you're in Paris, Berlin, or Rome. Paying per day with Firsty ensures a reliable connection without relying on WiFi for basic internet. This flexibility means you only pay for what you use and can avoid expensive bundles.

Can I create a hotspot with my eSIM Europe plan?

Yes! With Unlimited, you can create a hotspot in Europe to share your internet connection with others. This is perfect for connecting multiple devices or providing internet access to friends and family. Just enable the hotspot feature on your phone, and others can connect using your Unlimited connection. This feature is particularly useful when traveling with a group, especially during visits to iconic sites like the Eiffel Tower or the Colosseum.
